description:
Location groups
List every valid location for the `activity_location` and `org_location` filters on `stories_organization_list` and `stories_industry_location_list`. Returns all ~430 groups in one response (no paging), as a hierarchy: UN regions (e.g. "Asia", "Southern Asia"), then countries by ISO code (e.g. "IN", "FR"), then states or provinces for the US (via Census regions such as "Midwest"), AE, CA, CN and IN (e.g. "US-TX" is Texas, "CA-08" is Ontario). Each item has `id` (pass this, or `name` such as "texas", to the filters), `name`, `parent` and `children` (links to the groups above and below it). Filtering on a group includes everything beneath it. Free: no API key or payment needed.
name: location_groups_list
